label: REST
reason_for_inclusion: Baseline state used to arm live prediction and prevent repeated speech
notes: Not an ASL sign; required for stable one-shot demo flow.

label: HELLO
reason_for_inclusion: Common greeting and easy demo phrase
notes: Real ASL hello includes hand location/movement; glove version should be treated as a personalized static gesture.

label: YES
notes: Real ASL yes involves hand motion; glove version should use a repeatable finger-bend pattern.

label: NO
notes: Real ASL no uses index/middle/thumb motion; current glove can only approximate static finger shape.

label: THANK_YOU
notes: Pinky/thumb noise may make this less stable; real ASL thank-you depends on hand location/movement.

label: HELP
reason_for_inclusion: Emergency phrase is valuable for the FYP demo
notes: Real ASL help is commonly two-handed; current glove should use a personalized one-hand substitute.

label: PLEASE
notes: Real ASL please uses chest location/circular motion; glove version should be a custom static pattern.

label: STOP
notes: Real ASL stop uses two hands/contact; current glove needs a personalized one-hand substitute.

label: WATER
notes: Real ASL water involves handshape and location; glove version can use a distinct finger-bend pattern.

label: PAIN
notes: Real ASL pain uses location and movement; current glove should use a personalized static substitute.
